name: @gipity/chatbot

scripts.test: bash -c 'for t in tests/*.test.js; do node $t || exit 1; done'

description: Chatbot for any Gipity app: persona, scope guardrails, static knowledge (20k token budget), streaming Markdown replies, and tools: the model calls your app's own functions as the signed-in visitor (with approve/deny for actions). Saved conversations (this browser, or your app database per user), photos and text-file attachments, voice in and out, image generation, a model picker, stop / regenerate / edit. Corner bubble, inline panel or full-page chat with a conversation sidebar; or the headless engine for your own UI. On install it scaffolds src/js/chatbot.config.js - edit it, then mount('#bot', config).
